title: Beyond distance to a bus stop: revised replication package for Truong Tho Living Lab Paper 3

creators.name: Lê, Ngọc Hiếu
creators.affiliation: Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology; University of Health Sciences, VNU-HCM

description: Revised Paper3 analysis code and aggregate outputs linking the source-verified 2023 resident survey to historical OpenStreetMap access measures. See revision_20260920. Root-level notebook and results are historical and superseded. Full spatial replication requires authorized access to restricted survey coordinates and external PBF snapshots. Development metadata; no new release or DOI is asserted.
